reader_summary.headline: Renata Quintini and Roseanne Wincek are the Co-Founders and Managing Partners of Renegade Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Renata Quintini and Roseanne Wincek are the Co-Founders and Managing Partners of Renegade Partners. They raised a first fund of $100 million to focus on the "Supercritical Stage" of a company's development. Our conversation discusses the dynamics of a venture capital spinout and the nuances of a stage-focused strategy.

key_points.text: Renata Quintini and Roseanne Wincek are the Co-Founders and Managing Partners of Renegade Partners.
First, we dive into their backgrounds, lessons learned from their experience, forming a partnership and strategy together, and going to market.
Then, we discuss Renegade's investment process across sourcing, filtering, winning deals, and working with companies.
